message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/poppler && python3 - <<'PY'
import zipfile, re, os
z=zipfile.ZipFile('../pdf_fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip')
name='pdf.js/test/pdfs/IdentityToUnicodeMap_charCodeOf.pdf'
out='/workspace/candidate.pdf'
open(out,'wb').write(z.read(name))
print(out)
PY
./build.sh >/tmp/build.log 2>&1 || (tail -50 /tmp/build.log; exit 1)
./work-vul/poppler/utils/pdftotext /workspace/candidate.pdf - >/tmp/out.txt 2>/tmp/err.txt; ec=$?; echo EXIT:$ec; tail -50 /tmp/err.txt; head -20 /tmp/out.txt
